rows.question: Where do I request a replacement laptop and how long does it take?
rows.answer:
You request a replacement laptop in the IT portal under Hardware. Handover can take up to 5 business days after manager approval by IT staff. [hb-01-chunk-2][hb-01-chunk-1]
Source [hb-01-chunk-0]: "Laptop replacement: broken, lost or stolen laptops can be replaced."
Source [hb-01-chunk-1]: "After manager approval, a replacement laptop is set up by IT staff with your files, accounts, email and access rights, and handover can take up to 5 business days."
Source [hb-01-chunk-2]: "Report lost or stolen devices to security first. Request a replacement laptop in IT portal under Hardware."
Source [hb-01-chunk-3]: "Accessories such as mouse or headset are ordered through that same form."

rows.question: Where do I order a new headset?
rows.answer:
Order a new headset through the same form used for requesting a replacement laptop in the IT portal under Hardware. [hb-01-chunk-3]
Source [hb-01-chunk-2]: "Report lost or stolen devices to security first. Request a replacement laptop in IT portal under Hardware."
Source [hb-01-chunk-3]: "Accessories such as mouse or headset are ordered through that same form."

rows.question: When are the onboarding check-ins with my manager?
rows.answer:
Your manager schedules a check-in at the end of month one and again after three months. [hb-06-chunk-2]
Source [hb-06-chunk-0]: "New colleagues follow a two-week onboarding plan."
Source [hb-06-chunk-1]: "A buddy is assigned in your first week and helps you get started with tools, people and team habits."
Source [hb-06-chunk-2]: "Your manager schedules a check-in at end of month one and again after three months."

rows.question: Can I work from home four days a week?
rows.answer:
No. [hb-03-chunk-0]
Source [hb-03-chunk-0]: "Remote work: employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week."

Source [hb-03-chunk-2]: "Remote work days can be moved within same week."
